title: Update assessment limitations without rewriting neighboring work
actor: A reviewer refining a recorded assessment
goal: Save a deliberate limitations correction while preserving the assessment facts, findings, and other unselected content.
context: A complete current assessment already exists and its limitations need correction; the reviewer has not chosen a new judgment or applicability value.
trigger: The reviewer submits a limitations-only update.
preconditions: The selected current-format report is complete and readable.
The reviewer has obtained its actual current contract/revision and the intended decision basis.

interaction.action: Supplies the changed limitations and exact expected state for the selected report, requesting preview first if useful.
Returns a bounded preview of the intended changes without saving or reserving the state.
Explicitly submits the intended update for publication.
Checks the current expected state and records only the selected edit, preserving findings and unselected content, then reports the actual storage outcome.

expected_outcome: The selected limitations are saved without invented judgment, applicability, verified basis, or edits to neighboring values and bytes.

alternatives.condition: The supplied limitations are semantically unchanged and current preconditions still hold.
alternatives.outcome: The system reports unchanged and preserves existing bytes.

alternatives.condition: The reviewer also explicitly decides to change applicability.
alternatives.outcome: The owning task can publish the explicitly supplied applicability decision with the explanation change without inferring it from prose.

failures.condition: The report is missing or incomplete, the expected state has changed, or an unknown/non-explanation field is supplied.
failures.outcome: The system rejects or conflicts without constructing a partial assessment or silently retargeting the correction.

failures.condition: The update overlaps another assignment in the same task submission.
failures.outcome: The whole candidate rejects rather than silently choosing one actor value.
